dispositionOfExternalWanPostgrestPerform.authoritativeTarget: P95 < 50.0 ms (Historical / Informational Benchmark Target for direct database queries)
dispositionOfExternalWanPostgrestPerform.rationale: Direct WAN HTTP latency from the test runner (India) to remote cloud-hosted Supabase Staging (fkpigozcqnmcvofuksar) across public WAN is subject to public internet transit latency. In milestone W020-G9, empirical server-side decomposition proved that Supabase upstream service time is 34.00 ms P95 (within the 50 ms budget), while external network transit represented 98.42% of observed latency. DEC-107 formally adjudicated this as an environmental limitation. Under ratified PLAN-W021-G6-REV-1.0 Section 15, this was identified as an operational risk with mitigation 'Acknowledge remote staging network latency under CTO Environmental Exception (DEC-107)'. Therefore, direct staging WAN round-trip latency cannot be reliably measured within a <50ms window from this test execution environment without cloud co-location. All local Fastify gateway lookups and deterministic compute algorithms are verified sub-millisecond (0.065 ms P95).
